attempts.text: {"inventedFacts":[{"span":"Viggo watched from the chair by the hearth and said nothing.","severity":"minor","reason":"places Viggo at home; the briefing says he was maimed but not that he is at home, and the task allows only named people if at home"},{"span":"He had not eaten.","severity":"minor","reason":"adds a detail about Rook's status the briefing does not give"},{"span":"Kael Dunmore was still out there.","severity":"minor","reason":"stated as fact; the briefing says he escaped, so this is a mild inference about his current whereabouts"}],"voice":4,"clarity":4,"tone":4,"overall":3,"comment":"Restrained, clear scene that uses traits and the best-friend bond well and ends on the heir's resolve to hunt Dunmore.
